about.title: System Status
about.description: Computer Engineering graduate specializing in Low-Level Systems and Robotics
content: Hello! I'm Amr Eslim, a Computer Engineering graduate based in Berlin, Germany.
I completed my Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering at HTW Berlin in April 2025 with a focus on embedded architectures.
My expertise lies in Embedded Linux, Firmware Development, and High-Performance C++ Applications.
I have hands-on experience as a software developer at Fraunhofer IPK since May 2022, working on industrial-grade digital assistance systems for Industry 4.0.

My recent Bachelor's thesis on neurobiologically-inspired snake robotics demonstrates my ability to bridge control theory with efficient C++ implementation, combining CPG algorithms and real-time constraints.
With a strong background in C/C++, Rust, and Linux Kernel internals, I build reliable, memory-safe, and efficient solutions for complex technical challenges.
I'm particularly interested in developing autonomous robotics systems and optimizing low-level drivers for next-gen hardware.
Ready to deploy efficient code to production.

snake_robot.title: Snake Robot Firmware
snake_robot.subtitle: Embedded C++ • ESP32 • RTOS
snake_robot.description: High-performance firmware implementation for a modular bio-inspired snake robot. The system leverages CPG (Central Pattern Generator) algorithms running on ESP32 to achieve real-time coordinated servo control. Initialized complex kinematics solving and real-time state machine logic for adaptive locomotion.
features: ✅ **Embedded C++ Architecture**: Object-oriented firmware design optimized for constrained resources, featuring custom driver layers for servo bus communication.
✅ **Real-Time Control Loop**: Implemented strict timing-critical loops for CPG wave generation (10-45° amplitude, 0.1-2.0 Hz) ensuring synchronized motion across 10-DOF.
✅ **Hardware Abstraction Layer**: Developed HAL for ESP32 peripherals including PWM, ADC (Current Sensing), and UART/WiFi stacks.
✅ **Performance Profiling**: Integrated energy monitoring using ACS712 sensors to profile algorithmic efficiency of Lateral Undulation vs Sidewinding gaits.
✅ **Concurrency**: Utilized FreeRTOS tasks for separating critical motor control loops from telemetry and communication threads.
✅ **Wireless Telemetry**: Implemented efficient binary UDP protocol for real-time robot state visualization and parameter tuning.

cryptify.title: Cryptify Core
cryptify.subtitle: Rust • Cryptography • Memory Safety
cryptify.description: A high-security cryptographic storage engine built with Rust to demonstrate memory-safe systems programming. Implements zero-knowledge protocols and hardware-accelerated encryption primitives. Focuses on correctness, type safety, and efficient resource management.
features: ✅ **Rust Ownership Model**: Leveraged Rust's borrow checker to ensure memory safety without garbage collection, critical for security applications.
✅ **Systems Programming**: Implemented low-level cryptographic primitives using ring and argon2 libraries, optimizing for CPU instruction sets.
✅ **Concurrency**: Built with Actix for high-throughput async I/O, handling concurrent authentications with minimal overhead.
✅ **Docker Containerization**: Optimized multi-stage Docker builds for minimal container footprint (<50MB) and secure rootless execution.
✅ **Type-Safe Database Interactions**: used SQLx for compile-time verified queries, preventing SQL injection at the compiler level.
✅ **Security Architecture**: Implemented Argon2id key derivation and AES-256-GCM for authenticated encryption.

sidequester.title: SideQuester Firmware
sidequester.subtitle: LoRa • Hardware Design • C++
sidequester.description: Off-grid telemetry device firmware using LoRa radio modulation. Designed for long-range, low-power communication between independent nodes without infrastructure. Involved bare-metal sensor interfacing and power state optimization.
features: ✅ **LoRa Mesh Networking**: Implemented P2P LoRa communication protocol (868/915MHz) for reliable data packet transmission over 3km.
✅ **Hardware Interfacing**: Developed I2C drivers for HMC5883L compass and UART NMEA parsing for GPS modules.
✅ **Power Optimization**: Implemented deep-sleep state machines to extend battery life, waking only for synchronized transmission windows.
✅ **Embedded Graphics**: Direct frame-buffer manipulation for OLED display updates using reduced instruction cycles.
✅ **Interrupt Handling**: Optimized GPIO interrupt service routines for user input and radio triggers.

opencv_auto.title: Computer Vision Pipeline
opencv_auto.subtitle: Python • OpenCV • Image Processing
opencv_auto.description: Automated image processing pipeline for real-time object detection. Implements standard CV algorithms for tracking and classification in video streams.
features: ✅ **Image Processing Algorithms**: Implementation of Canny Edge detection, Gaussian Blurring, and Contour finding.
✅ **Matrix Operations**: Efficient NumPy array manipulations for pixel-data processing.
✅ **Motion Tracking**: Euclidean distance tracking logic for persistent object identity.
